name: Nakano (Nagano, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Nakano city emblem in white: a cog-like device enclosing a ring with a vertical bar.
history: Municipal flag of Nakano, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in November 1933.

features.role: Nakano city emblem — a cog-like device enclosing a ring with a vertical bar
